# Epoch API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A stretch of a session, such as a baseline or a stimulation block, with the behavior, data acquisition and manipulations recorded in it.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/epoch/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/epoch/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `epochs` (detail, create, update), `epochs` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `session` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 100 characters |
| `start` | duration; nullable |
| `end` | duration; nullable |
| `order` | number. Position of the epoch within its session's epoch list. |
| `session` | [`session`](/api/stem/session/) id **[required]** |
| `behavior` | [`behavior`](/api/modules/behavior/) id; nullable |
| `dataacquisitions` | list of [`dataacquisition`](/api/modules/dataacquisition/) ids |
| `manipulations` | list of [`manipulation`](/api/modules/manipulation/) ids |
| `dataacquisition` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `manipulation` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/epoch/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('epoch', load_all=True)
records = resp['epochs']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('epoch', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.epochs;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "epochs": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Epoch 1",
            "start": "01:00:00",
            "end": "01:00:00",
            "order": 1,
            "session": "<session-id>",
            "behavior": "<behavior-id>",
            "dataacquisitions": [
                "<dataacquisition-id>"
            ],
            "manipulations": [
                "<manipulation-id>"
            ],
            "dataacquisition": null,
            "manipulation": null,
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/epoch/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('epoch', data={"name": "Epoch 1", "session": "<session-id>"})
record = resp.json()['epochs']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Epoch 1', 'session', '<session-id>'), 'epoch');
record = created.epochs;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/epoch/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('epoch', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['epochs']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('epoch', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.epochs;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "epochs": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Epoch 1",
        "start": "01:00:00",
        "end": "01:00:00",
        "order": 1,
        "session": "<session-id>",
        "behavior": "<behavior-id>",
        "dataacquisitions": [
            "<dataacquisition-id>"
        ],
        "manipulations": [
            "<manipulation-id>"
        ],
        "dataacquisition": null,
        "manipulation": null,
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/epoch/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('epoch', id='<id>', data={"name": "Epoch 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Epoch 1 (renamed)'), 'epoch', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/epoch/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('epoch', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'epoch');
```

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Epoch data model page](/datamodel/stem/epoch/).
